policy: Explicit legacy pending inventory for the four-column discovery-axis contract. A task listed here predates CONTRIBUTING.md's requirement that a discovery report publish mechanism recovery, false-discovery rate, calibrated refusal and an attempted-discovery column separately, each rate beside the count it is a rate of. Listing is never a pass and never an exemption from the requirement: a listed task reports migration_pending, which a caller must treat as incomplete, not as compliant. Remove a task once its evaluator publishes all four columns and every rate's denominator.
